implemented_requirements.requirement: Flap control (key press makes bird rise)
implemented_requirements.evidence: game.handle_events() maps SPACE/UP to bird.flap(); Bird.flap() sets velocity = FLAP_STRENGTH
Bird.update() adds GRAVITY to velocity each frame and updates y position
Pipe.__init__ chooses gap_center randomly within limits; Game.spawn_pipe_if_needed creates Pipe with gap size +/- variation

implemented_requirements.requirement: Score increments when passing a pipe
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.update() checks if pipe.x + PIPE_WIDTH < bird.x and increments self.score

implemented_requirements.requirement: Collision detection with pipes and ground
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.update() uses pipe.collides(bird.hitbox) and bird.y + BIRD_HEIGHT/2 >= SCREEN_HEIGHT - GROUND_HEIGHT to trigger game_over()
Game.game_over() sets bird.alive = False, changes state, plays hit sound, updates high score
Game.update_difficulty() adjusts self.speed and self.gap_size based on current score

implemented_requirements.requirement: Rendering of bird, pipes, ground, clouds, UI
implemented_requirements.evidence: Bird.draw, Pipe.draw, Ground.draw, Game._draw_clouds, ui module functions are implemented

critical_issues: ground.py uses SCREEN_WIDTH in draw() without importing it, causing a NameError at runtime and preventing the game loop from completing.
Because of the missing import, the game is unlikely to run successfully even though most gameplay logic is present.
judge.summary: The codebase implements the core Flappy Bird mechanics—flapping, gravity, pipe generation with random gaps, scoring, collision detection, game‑over state, and difficulty scaling. However, a fatal runtime error in ground.py (missing SCREEN_WIDTH import) makes the program non‑executable in its current form. Consequently, the submission does not meet the pass criteria.
